summary: E-Rate is critical for schools and libraries to maintain affordable, reliable access to the Internet. Terminating that support represents a cut to school and library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading those networks. Cutting E-Rate also threatens to leave vulnerable communities behind that don’t have dedicated resources to fill the gap.

claims.argument: Terminating E-Rate cuts school and library budgets, jeopardizing network upgrades
claims.evidence_quote: Terminating that support represents a cut to school and library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading those networks.
